name: Ashika Credit Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Ashika Credit Capital Ltd provides loans and advances, inter-corporate deposits, loans against securities, and investments in shares and securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a flagship company of the Ashika Group. It is an RBI-registered non- deposit-taking non-banking financial company. Company is engaged in fund-based activities viz. providing loans and investments

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Working capital days have increased from 42.9 days to 108 days
